Alternating_Cable_Shoulder_Press: Stand between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one arm up until straight and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other and keep alternating.
Alternating_Kettlebell_Press: Hold a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position, at shoulder height.
Press one until your arm is straight and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other and keep alternating, without arching your back.
Arnold_Dumbbell_Press: Seated or standing, hold the dumbbells in front of your shoulders with your palms facing you.
Press up while rotating your wrists to finish with your palms facing forward and your arms straight.
Barbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise: Lie on an incline bench holding a barbell over your chest with your arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, push the bar up, lifting your shoulder blades off the bench.
Return with control. It is a short range.
Barbell_Rear_Delt_Row: Stand with the bar in your hands, leaning forward with a straight back.
Pull the bar to your upper chest with your elbows very wide, in line with your shoulders.
Bent_Over_Dumbbell_Rear_Delt_Raise_With_: Standing, lean forward until your forehead rests on a bench, a dumbbell hanging in each hand.
Open your arms out to the sides with your elbows slightly bent.
Lower with control. Resting your head stops you from swinging.
Bent_Over_Low-Pulley_Side_Lateral: Stand side-on to a low pulley and grab the handle with the far hand. Lean your torso forward.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Return with control and switch sides.
Bradford_Rocky_Presses: Seated or standing, with the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Press it just over your head and lower it behind to the back of your neck.
Bring it back over the front and keep alternating. Use a light weight: the behind-the-neck part demands a lot of mobility.
Cable_Internal_Rotation: Stand side-on to a pulley at elbow height, handle in the nearer hand, elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm towards your stomach without moving your elbow away from your body.
Return with control and switch sides.
Cable_Rear_Delt_Fly: Stand between two pulleys at shoulder height and cross the cables: your right hand holds the left one and vice versa.
With your arms almost straight, open them backwards until they are out to the sides.
Cable_Rope_Rear-Delt_Rows: Attach a rope to a pulley at chest height.
Pull towards your face, separating your hands, with your elbows high and wide.
Cable_Shoulder_Press: Sit or stand between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Car_Drivers: Stand holding a plate with both hands in front of your chest, arms straight.
Turn it from side to side like a steering wheel, without lowering your arms.
Hold the position for the set time or reps.
Clean_and_Press: Set up as for a deadlift, with the bar in front of your legs.
Pull the bar up explosively until it rests on your shoulders (the clean).
Press it overhead until your arms are straight and lower it in two stages. Technical: start with a light weight.
Cuban_Press: Stand with light dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Raise your elbows to shoulder height, rotate your forearms up until vertical and press overhead.
Lower by reversing the steps. It is a shoulder-health exercise: use very little weight.
Double_Kettlebell_Jerk: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position on your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly, drive up and drop under them while your arms lock out overhead.
Stand up with the kettlebells overhead and lower them with control.
Double_Kettlebell_Push_Press: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position on your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly and use the drive from your legs to press them overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders with control.
Dumbbell_Incline_Shoulder_Raise: Lie on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand over your chest and your arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, push the dumbbells up, lifting your shoulder blades off the bench.
Dumbbell_Lying_One-Arm_Rear_Lateral_Rais: Lie on your side on a bench with a dumbbell in your top hand, hanging in front of your body.
Raise your arm towards the ceiling with your elbow slightly bent.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Dumbbell_Lying_Rear_Lateral_Raise: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell hanging in each hand.
Open your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Dumbbell_One-Arm_Shoulder_Press: Standing or seated, with a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height.
Press it until your arm is straight without leaning your body.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Dumbbell_One-Arm_Upright_Row: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Pull up, leading with a high elbow, until your hand reaches your chest.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Dumbbell_Scaption: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, thumbs up.
Raise your straight arms diagonally, halfway between the front and the side, to shoulder height.
External_Rotation: Lie on your side with a dumbbell in your top hand and your elbow at your side, bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm upwards without moving your elbow away from your body.
Lower with control and switch sides. Use very little weight.
External_Rotation_with_Band: Hold a band anchored to one side at elbow height, with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outwards without moving your elbow.
Return with control and switch sides.
External_Rotation_with_Cable: Stand side-on to a pulley at elbow height, handle in the far hand and elbow at your side.
Rotate your forearm outwards without moving your elbow.
Return with control and switch sides.
Front_Cable_Raise: With your back to a low pulley, hold the handle in one hand between your legs.
Raise your straight arm in front to shoulder height.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Front_Dumbbell_Raise: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise one straight arm in front to shoulder height and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other or raise both at once.
Front_Incline_Dumbbell_Raise: Sit on an incline bench with your back supported and a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your straight arms in front to shoulder height.
Front_Two-Dumbbell_Raise: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise both straight arms in front to shoulder height.
Lower with control without swinging your body.
Internal_Rotation_with_Band: Hold a band anchored to one side at elbow height, with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm towards your stomach without moving your elbow.
Return with control and switch sides.
Jerk_Balance: With the bar on the front of your shoulders and your feet in a short split stance.
Drive the bar up while stepping forward with your front foot, finishing with your arms locked out.
Recover the position with control. Technical: use a light weight.
Kettlebell_Halo: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle in front of your chest.
Circle it around your head, passing behind your neck, without moving your torso.
Do the set number of circles one way and then the other.
Kettlebell_Halo_With_Overhead_Extension: Circle the kettlebell around your head once as a halo.
When it comes back to the front, press it overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it and repeat in the other direction.
Kettlebell_Pirate_Ships: Stand with your feet apart holding a kettlebell with both hands, arms straight out in front.
Rotate your torso, swinging the kettlebell in an arc to one side and then the other.
Keep your abs tight and your arms straight.
Kettlebell_Seesaw_Press: Hold a kettlebell in each hand in the rack position.
Press one up while the other comes down, like a seesaw.
Keep the rhythm without arching your back.
Kettlebell_Thruster: Hold one or two kettlebells in the rack position on your shoulders.
Squat down and, as you stand, use the momentum to press the kettlebells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go straight into the next rep.
Kettlebell_Turkish_Get-Up_Lunge_style: Lie on your back with the kettlebell in one hand, arm straight towards the ceiling and the knee on that side bent.
Keeping your eyes on the kettlebell, sit up onto the other elbow and then the hand, lift your hips and sweep the straight leg behind you until you are kneeling.
Stand up as if from a lunge and reverse the steps to get back to the floor. Learn it without weight first.
Kettlebell_Turkish_Get-Up_Squat_style: Lie on your back with the kettlebell in one hand and your arm straight towards the ceiling.
Sit up onto the other elbow and hand, lift your hips and bring your legs under your body into a squat.
Stand up and reverse the steps. Learn it without weight first.
Landmine_Linear_Jammer: Set one end of the bar in a corner or holder and hold the other with both hands in front of your chest.
Drop into a half squat and, as you stand, press the bar up and forward until your arms are straight.
Leverage_Shoulder_Press: Sit in the machine with your back supported and the handles at shoulder height.
Press until your arms are straight.
Low_Pulley_Row_To_Neck: Stand facing a low pulley with a rope or bar.
Pull towards your neck with your elbows high and wide.
Lying_One-Arm_Lateral_Raise: Lie on your side on a bench with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Raise your straight arm until it is vertical.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Lying_Rear_Delt_Raise: Lie face down on a flat or incline bench with the dumbbells hanging.
Open your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Machine_Shoulder_Military_Press: Sit in the machine with your back supported and the handles at shoulder height.
Press until your arms are straight.
One-Arm_Incline_Lateral_Raise: Lie on your side on an incline bench with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Raise your arm until it is vertical.
Lower with control and switch sides.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Clean_and_Jerk: With the kettlebell between your legs, bring it up to the rack position with a hip drive.
Dip your knees slightly and drive it overhead, dropping your body under it.
Stand up, lower it and repeat. Switch hands.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Jerk: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Dip your knees slightly, drive up and drop under it with your arm locked out.
Stand up and lower it with control. Switch hands.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Military_Press_To_The: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Lean slightly to the opposite side as you press it up.
Lower it with control and switch sides.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Push_Press: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Dip your knees slightly and use the drive from your legs to press it overhead.
Lower it with control and switch hands.
One-Arm_Kettlebell_Split_Jerk: Hold the kettlebell in the rack position on your shoulder.
Drive with your legs and press it up while splitting your legs.
Bring your feet together with your arm straight and lower it with control.
One-Arm_Side_Laterals: Stand holding on to something stable with one hand and a dumbbell in the other.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Power_Partials: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do short, fast lateral raises in the bottom part of the range.
Keep the pace throughout the set without swinging your body.
Push_Press_-_Behind_the_Neck: With the bar on your upper back and a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly and use the drive from your legs to press the bar overhead.
Lower it with control. It demands good shoulder mobility: use a light weight.
Reverse_Flyes_With_External_Rotation: Lean forward with a straight back and a light dumbbell in each hand.
Open your arms out to the sides and, at the top, rotate your forearms upwards.
Undo the rotation and lower with control.
Reverse_Machine_Flyes: Sit in the fly machine facing the backrest, chest against the pad.
Grab the handles and open your arms backwards until they are out to the sides.
Seated_Barbell_Military_Press: Sit on a bench with an upright backrest and the bar at shoulder height.
Press it until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower with control to your chin.
Seated_Cable_Shoulder_Press: Sit on a bench between two low pulleys with a handle in each hand at shoulder height.
Press until your arms are straight.
See-Saw_Press_Alternating_Side_Press: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one up while leaning slightly to the opposite side.
Lower it while pressing the other up, like a seesaw.
Side_Laterals_to_Front_Raise: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, bring them to the front and lower them.
On the next rep, do the path in reverse.
Single-Arm_Linear_Jammer: Set one end of the bar in a corner and hold the other with one hand at shoulder height.
Drop into a half squat and, as you stand, press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Return with control and switch sides.
Single_Dumbbell_Raise: Stand holding one dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it with your arms straight to shoulder height.
Smith_Incline_Shoulder_Raise: Lie on an incline bench under the Smith machine bar with your arms straight.
Without bending your elbows, push the bar up, lifting your shoulder blades off the bench.
Smith_Machine_One-Arm_Upright_Row: Standing side-on to the Smith machine, grab the bar with one hand in front of your thigh.
Pull up with a high elbow to chest height.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Smith_Machine_Overhead_Shoulder_Press: Sit on a bench under the Smith machine bar, set at shoulder height.
Press until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your chin.
Standing_Alternating_Dumbbell_Press: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one up and lower it with control.
Repeat with the other without arching your back.
Standing_Barbell_Press_Behind_Neck: Stand with the bar on your upper back and a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Press it until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower with control only as far as is comfortable. If you feel discomfort, press from the front instead.
Standing_Bradford_Press: Stand with the bar on the front of your shoulders.
Press it just over your head and lower it behind to the back of your neck.
Bring it back over the front and keep alternating. Light weight.
Standing_Dumbbell_Press: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press until your arms are straight overhead.
Standing_Dumbbell_Straight-Arm_Front_Del: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Raise your straight arms in front until they are overhead.
Lower with control. Use a light weight.
Standing_Front_Barbell_Raise_Over_Head: Stand holding a barbell or plate in front of your thighs with your arms straight.
Raise it in front until it is overhead.
Standing_Low-Pulley_Deltoid_Raise: Standing side-on to a low pulley, with the handle in the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Standing_Military_Press: Stand with the bar resting in front of your shoulders and your hands slightly wider than them.
Squeeze your abs and glutes and press the bar straight up until your arms are straight.
Lower with control to your chin.
Standing_Palm-In_One-Arm_Dumbbell_Press: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height, palm facing in.
Press it until your arm is straight.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Standing_Palms-In_Dumbbell_Press: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing each other.
Press until your arms are straight.
Straight_Raises_on_Incline_Bench: Lie face down on an incline bench with a light bar hanging in your hands.
Raise the bar in front with straight arms to head height.
Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Clean: Place two kettlebells between your feet.
With a straight back, bring them up with a hip drive to the rack position on your shoulders.
Lower them with control and repeat.
Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Jerk: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position on your shoulders.
Dip your knees slightly, drive up and drop under them with your arms locked out.
Stand up and lower them with control.
Two-Arm_Kettlebell_Military_Press: Hold two kettlebells in the rack position on your shoulders.
Press them until your arms are straight without arching your back.
Upright_Barbell_Row: Stand with the bar in front of your thighs and a grip slightly narrower than your shoulders.
Pull up with your elbows high until the bar reaches your chest.
Lower with control. Do not go higher if your shoulders bother you.
